job.job_description:
Backend Engineer

Chennai/Bengaluru/Hyderabad Hybrid

4 + years

Preferred: Healthcare Domain




Must Have Skills: Python, Gen AI, RAG, LLM, AWS/Azure, SQL




Required Qualifications



46 years of backend engineering experience; Python strongly preferred, with FastAPI or an equivalent async framework.
Hands-on experience building with LLMs agent design, prompt engineering, structured output, and tool / function calling including RAG / knowledge-base grounding, guardrails, and graceful fallback handling when model confidence is low.
AWS proficiency: EventBridge, ECS Fargate, Lambda, RDS PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
Event-driven architecture fundamentals: at-least-once delivery, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and saga patterns.
PostgreSQL depth: schema design, constraint authoring, and index strategy.
Solid grasp of REST API design, asynchronous programming, and automated testing.
Ability to own a service end-to-end in a fast-moving, milestone-gated sprint without hand-holding.
Hands-on experience using an agentic AI platform (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot Agents, Windsurf) across the software development lifecycle from coding and testing to debugging and code review.

AI-assisted engineering is core to how we build at Simplify Alpha. Hands-on fluency with agentic AI platforms across the software development lifecycle is essential for this role.

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare domain: EDI 270/271 / 837/835 transactions, Medicaid eligibility, or claims workflows.
Prompt evaluation frameworks: LangSmith, PromptFlow, or custom evaluation harness experience.
Kinesis Data Streams consumer implementation and real-time telemetry ingestion patterns.
React 18 / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS; ESRI or Google APIs for real-time map UIs.
Pulumi Infrastructure-as-Code, AWS multi-AZ deployment patterns, and Redshift Serverless materialized view design.

Technology Stack

You will work across an event-driven, AI-native platform stack on AWS:

Layer Technologies

Languages Python, SQL, TypeScript

Backend Python (FastAPI), async event-driven microservices, Pydantic

AI & Agents AWS Bedrock AgentCore, prompt engineering, LLM tool / function calling, evaluation harnesses

Cloud (AWS) ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, multi-AZ RDS

Eventing & Streaming AWS EventBridge, Kinesis Data Streams (real-time telemetry), SQS

IaC & Automation Pulumi (Infrastructure-as-Code from day one)

CI/CD GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines

Data & Caching RDS PostgreSQL (multi-AZ), DynamoDB, Redshift Serverless, ElastiCache Redis
